Headline: Green Line Delays
ShortDescription: Green Line trains are running w/residual delays following earlier track conditions at Harlem/Lake. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Green Line trains are running w/residual delays following earlier track conditions at Harlem/Lake.

Shuttle buses are available from Harlem/Lake to Ashland/Lake in both directions until 1710 to provide service through the affected area. 

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
